Here are the details on the 3BR in Urban Oasis:

The price is AED 12,000/month, all-inclusive, meaning VAT, water, electricity, and internet are all covered. You can book monthly, up to 12 months, and moving in on the 8th works perfectly.

To get you registered with building management for a viewing, could you send a photo of your passport or Emirates ID?
